Binance Reports 90% Recovery After $6.3bn Hack, While FBI Attributes Attack to North Korea

01 Nov 2026, 05:33 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily World Desk · Source: www.theguardian.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysCryptocurrency exchange Binance announced that it has replaced 90% of the funds stolen during a record $6.3 billion security breach. According to reports, the incident led to suspended user withdrawals and triggered a downturn across major digital asset markets.

Image: Guardian staff and agencies · Source image rights not independently verified · Photo source · Cropped to 16:9 for the website

In this article
  1. Incident Details and Recovery Efforts
  2. FBI Attribution and Investigations

Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced that it has replaced 90% of the funds stolen during a record $6.3 billion security breach. According to reports, the incident led to suspended user withdrawals and triggered a downturn across major digital asset markets.

Incident Details and Recovery Efforts

Binance stated that the remaining 10% of stolen tokens consist of less liquid assets, which may require more time to reacquire. Co-CEO Richard Teng confirmed that the platform intends to cover the remaining balance so that users do not experience financial losses.

To fund the token re-purchases, the exchange utilized:

  • A portion of its $1 billion Secure Asset Fund for Users (SAFU)
  • Contributions from its Futures Insurance Fund
  • Allocations from the company's corporate treasury

Binance suspended user withdrawals following the breach, but reported on Sunday that withdrawals were beginning to resume in phased rollouts to maintain platform stability. Teng described the breach as a complex attack involving a compromised laptop and malicious software designed to remove activity logs and hinder investigation efforts.

FBI Attribution and Investigations

The Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) issued a statement attributing the theft to TraderTraitor, a North Korea-affiliated group believed to be linked to the Lazarus Group. The law enforcement agency reported tracking these actors as they convert stolen virtual assets into Ethereum and urged private sector entities to block transactions tied to identified laundering addresses.

Market Impact

Following news of the hack and subsequent disruptions:

  • Bitcoin declined by nearly 5%
  • Ethereum dropped by nearly 6%
  • BNB, the native token of Binance, fell by approximately 10%

Observers can verify original company announcements and updates directly through Binance's official social media channels, such as their designated account on X, and official statements published by the FBI.
